articles.title: GTA 6 leaker cashes out of his own memecoin hours before Rockstar's gameplay reveal
articles.snippet: The token hit a $25 million market cap on the back of nine days of unreleased Grand Theft Auto VI footage. Its creator has now sold his stack — hours before Rockstar's first official gameplay reveal.

articles.title: 240 UK taxpayers made more than $1.3 million each from crypto holdings in fiscal 2025
articles.snippet: For the first time, the U.K.'s tax office broke out crypto capital gains figures, showing 17,600 people reported $1.87 billion in profits during the 2024-2025 tax year.

articles.title: Crypto traders brace for Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s Jackson Hole speech
articles.snippet: One analyst expects Warsh to take a tough line on inflation, but still sees the Fed holding off on rate hikes until at least after the November mid-term elections.

articles.title: Bitfinex Securities raises $50 million in push to offer tokenized nickel trading
articles.snippet: Bitfinex Securities is preparing to list a new security linked to a Luxembourg-based industrial metals platform built around a $1.6 billion stockpile of high-purity nickel wire.

articles.title: Trump cost investors $4.7B through crypto ‘schemes’: Public Citizen
articles.snippet: While investors in World Liberty Financial‘s USD1 stablecoin “haven’t suffered major losses,” many lost billions of dollars in other Trump ventures, according to Public Citizen.
